name: Matilda 'Tilly' Hayes
bio: The woman with whom George Ives had a long-running relationship from the 1910s to the 1940s, and with whom he discussed having a child; she stood third in line to inherit the Adelaide Road house under his 1939 will, after Bloodworth and Saunders and ahead of his kin.
bio_note: All from Cook, Queer Domesticities (2014), p. 105; Cook's endnote 61 credits the identification of Hayes with the diary's 'certain girl' to Brian Lewis by personal communication, with no archival citation.
